Claim 21 (currently amended): The airfoil according to claim 20, wherein the leading edge sweep angle at the 0% span position and a leading edge sweep angle at the 100% span position are positive and approximately equal.

Claim 25 (currently amended): The airfoil according to claim 1, wherein the airfoil is a fan blade for a gas turbine engine, and wherein the airfoil has a trailing edge sweep angle in a range of 100 to 150. 

Claim 26 (currently amended): A gas turbine engine comprising: a combustor section arranged between a compressor section and a turbine section; a fan section having an array of twenty-six or fewer fan blades, wherein the fan section has a low fan pressure ratio of less than 1.55; a geared architecture coupling the fan section to the turbine section or the compressor section; and wherein the fan blades include an airfoil having pressure and suction sides, the airfoil extends in a radial direction from a 0% span position at an inner flow path location to a 100% span position at an airfoil tip, wherein the airfoil has a curve corresponding to a relationship between a trailing edge sweep angle and a span position, wherein the trailing edge sweep angle is in a range of 100 to 200 in a range of 40-70% span position, and the trailing edge sweep angle is positive from 0% span to at least 95% span, and wherein the trailing edge sweep angle transitions smoothly along the curve from the 0% span position to the 100% span position.

Claim 28 (currently amended): The gas turbine engine according to claim 27, wherein the low fan pressure ratio is less than 1.52 and additionally characterized by a specific design feature of the fan blades that enhances aerodynamic efficiency. 

Claim 29 (currently amended): The gas turbine engine according to claim 28, wherein the low fan pressure ratio is less than 1.50 and the fan blades are designed to optimize airflow characteristics along the pressure and suction sides.

Claim 30 (currently amended): The gas turbine engine according to claim 29, wherein the low fan pressure ratio is less than 1.48 and includes specific blade geometries to maintain stability during operation.
